Metadata.title: At-Taqwa Institute
Metadata.description: System-based, sustainable, high-quality Islamic education combining modern management science with Islamic values.

Home.heroText: By combining modern management science with Islamic values, we help move madrasa education from person-dependency to system-dependency.
Home.pillarTraining: Training programs for teachers, administrators, and parents.
Home.pillarConsultancy: Madrasa management, curriculum, and institutional assessment.
Home.pillarDigital: The 9-Step Student Monitoring System and Knowledge Hub.
Home.missionText: Build a system-based, sustainable, high-quality model for Hifzul Quran, maktab and Islamic general education by fusing modern management principles with timeless Islamic values.
Home.visionText: Move madrasa management from person-dependency to system-dependency, and scale this model to hundreds of educational institutions nationwide.
Home.liveModelQuote: What we teach, we implement in our own live institution.
Home.liveModelText: Madrasatut Taqwa is our sister institution, where the Institute's management and teaching methods are put into practice every day. Hifz, maktab and residential student admissions are handled on Madrasatut Taqwa's own website.
Home.featuredText: Online and offline courses — seats are limited, so apply early.
Home.featuredEmpty: New courses will be announced soon.
Home.methodText: We follow the same five steps in every institution, so change rests on the system, not on one person.

methodSteps.title: Identify
methodSteps.text: Find the institution's current state, problems and needs.

methodSteps.title: Develop
methodSteps.text: Prepare SOPs, curriculum and a plan that fit those needs.

methodSteps.title: Build
methodSteps.text: Build the skills of teachers and administrators through training.

methodSteps.title: Implement
methodSteps.text: Put the plan into the institution's daily work.

methodSteps.title: Evaluate
methodSteps.text: Measure the results and set the next improvements.

Home.institutionsText: Madrasas and schools implementing our management SOPs, training and monitoring model.
Home.institutionsMessage: Assalamu alaikum, we would like At-Taqwa Institute's consultancy service for our institution.
Home.monitoringText: A complete method for teachers and parents to follow each student's progress every day. The software launches in a later phase; institutions can join the waitlist now.
Home.monitoringMessage: Assalamu alaikum, we are interested in the 9-Step Student Monitoring System for our institution. Please add us to the waitlist.
Home.ctaText: Contact us about course enrollment, institutional consultancy or any question.

madrasaTeacher.title: Madrasa Teachers
madrasaTeacher.who: Maktab, Nazera, Hifz and Kitab division instructors
madrasaTeacher.need: Structured pedagogy, Quran recitation correction and student psychology training

generalTeacher.title: General School Teachers
generalTeacher.who: Teachers from Bangla/English medium and general Islamic schools
generalTeacher.need: Classroom management, child behavioural guidance and moral education

administrator.title: Muhtamims & Principals
administrator.who: Founders, principals and directors of madrasas
administrator.need: Institutional transformation, administrative and financial SOPs, student retention

institution.title: Educational Institutions
institution.who: Madrasas and schools seeking partnership or a full systemic overhaul
institution.need: Institution audits, faculty training packages and continuous monitoring

parent.title: Parents & Guardians
parent.who: Parents conscious of their children's deen, tarbiyah and wellbeing
parent.need: Practical guidance on screen addiction, adolescence and balanced upbringing

researcher.title: Researchers & Academics
researcher.who: Islamic scholars, educators and curriculum researchers
researcher.need: Research papers, modern madrasa models and education statistics
